name: claude-code
description: Anthropic's Claude Code CLI (@anthropic-ai/claude-code 2.1.310), run headless (claude -p --output-format stream-json --include-partial-messages) with permissions skipped inside the sandbox, on any Anthropic Messages-shaped provider (the default model is claude-sonnet-5-5, Anthropic's newest mid-tier model). The request's user input becomes the prompt and its files are placed in the workspace; instructions and system/developer messages are appended to the system prompt; reasoning.effort, text.format json_schema and max_tool_calls map to the CLI's own flags; the turn's MCP servers become its MCP config, narrowed by allowed_tools; turns after the first resume the CLI's session. Assistant text streams token by token; thinking becomes reasoning items, Bash runs become shell_call items, Write/Edit/MultiEdit become apply_patch_call items, MCP tools become mcp_call items and every other tool a function_call, each with its output; token usage is reported on the final response and unsupported request fields in metadata.hg_ignored_fields.
